cohort: The study included 329 pregnant patients without complications, aged 18-45 years, with an estimated gestational age > 37 weeks, and no history of previous caesarian section, intrauterine growth restriction, fetal anomalies, prior uterine surgery, or uterine abnormalities.
finding: A cervical length (CL) of less than 30mm, measured between 37 and 38 weeks of gestation, was a predictor of spontaneous labor and delivery within a week.
cross-section timing: at term pregnancy, specifically between 37 and 38 weeks of gestation, and within 7 days of potential spontaneous birth
gest_age: greater than 37 weeks (mean GA 36.91 +- 0.6 weeks for the enrolled patients, with findings specified for 37-38 weeks)
